annotation.justification: The clause "A client MAY attempt to resend data in 0-RTT packets after it sends a new Initial packet" does not constrain the nature of the data to be resent. This omission allows two materially different implementation behaviours: (1) resending the exact same payload that was originally sent in the 0‑RTT packets, or (2) sending new or modified payloads in subsequent 0‑RTT packets. The lack of a constraint on the data content constitutes an incomplete constraint (U-2).
annotation.missing_information: Whether the data that a client attempts to resend in 0‑RTT packets must be identical to the data originally sent in the 0‑RTT packets, or whether it may be new data, is not specified.
